label: For "Service Request Triage (311)": Classify and route non-emergency service requests such as potholes, graffiti and noise from text and photos to the right team with a priority, so residents get faster fixes. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Prioritising by request volume.
